Tara H (Partnerships): Quick sync request 1: CloudFoundry SI asked for a short LangChain + gateway sandbox demo for their clients next month. Need marketplace listing basics + an integration checklist.

Ibrahim S (Eng): From eng: Do they want a LangChain runner only or also a persistence example (LlamaIndex)?

Tara H (Partnerships): They prefer LangChain with a simple vector store example (LlamaIndex basic usage) so customers can see retrieval + routing.

Lina V (Product): Deliverables: sample app, short perf sheet, SKU suggestion, and a note on Private deployment networking. I can draft SKU copy if we get perf numbers.

Marco J (DevEx): I'll prepare a lightweight demo repo and a Terraform snippet to spin the gateway with a CI workflow. Will include a README "How it maps to marketplace".

Ellen R (Marketing): Timeline? SI wants a soft preview on May 22. We need a 1-pager and a canned demo script by May 15.

Tara H (Partnerships): Can we target tech sign-off by May 10? Nina, legal needs the data flow and partner co-marketing language.

Nina K (Legal): Send the dataflow and draft coop wording. Recommend using "Validated with CloudFoundry SI" instead of "Certified". Also confirm no customer data is persisted to our hosted logs.

Ibrahim S (Eng): For perf, test redwood-7b + redwood-13b-q4, seq 512, 1024, batch 1/4. PerfBot please queue under tag cf-si-1743.

PerfBot: queued perf job. Provide GCS path and prompt CSV.

Marco J (DevEx): Uploading prompts and demo repo to gs://redwood-partners/cf-si-1743 now, PR soon.

Lina V (Product): Also add a fallback policy note: auto-fallback to hosted variant on capacity issues. We'll include that in the marketplace copy.

Tara H (Partnerships): Action items:
- Ibrahim: compatibility notes + perf matrix (due TOM)
- Marco: demo repo + prompts (due TOM AM)
- Nina: legal review once dataflow posted (due May 12)
- Ellen: marketing assets draft after perf numbers (due May 15)
- Lina: SKU copy (due May 13)

Ellen R (Marketing): Got it. I'll prep the 1-pager template and a short demo outline.

Tara H (Partnerships): Thanks all. We'll do a readout next Wed 11am PT.
